review.note: The item's P580 and P582 give 14 to 21 July 1950; the record's own cited article at revision 1370312872 dates the battle "16–20 July 1950 (4 days)" in its infobox and "(16–20 July 1950)" in its first sentence. A7 licenses widening an interval from the cited article and not narrowing one, so the wider bounds the item states are kept and this is the note that says two cited sources disagree about four days.

title: Battle of Taejon
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Taejon", at revision 1370312872, opens: "The Battle of Taejon was an early battle of the Korean War, between U.S. and North Korean forces. Forces of the United States Army attempted to defend the headquarters of the 24th Infantry Division." Wikidata item Q492880, whose own description reads "1950 battle of the Korean War". That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does.
